correctness.rationale: Use the already published exact piecewise Kravchenko formula: M=2^-alpha left and M=2 a_alpha d_alpha^alpha right with a=(alpha+3-sqrt(alpha²+6alpha+1))/4, d=(3alpha+1-sqrt(...))/(2alpha). Stationarity of log(2a)+alpha log[(1-2a)/(1-a)] removes da/dalpha in differentiation, giving right log derivative log d and left -log 2; alpha0>2 implies d0>1/2, so nonzero positive jump. Exact formal expansion in t=1/alpha yields log[M/(2t/e)]=-3t/2+13t²/6-21t³/4+O(t^4), hence relative -3/2 and 79/24. Independent SymPy rational-series calculation and numeric alpha0 root/slope checks agree. Relies entirely on published exact optimizer formula and does not reprove its global validity.
